disclaimer: TAM/SAM/SOM bottom-up model with cited public data (ODMD, TÜİK, BDDK, industry reports). Revenue SOM tied to financial-model base Y3.
methodology: TAM = addressable transaction & credit pool; SAM = monetizable decision sessions × ARPU; SOM = 36-month base-case ARR.
